heading_path: SPPN 2/2023: Public Procurement - Annual Procurement Reports for 2022-23 and 2023-2024

content_blocks.text: SPPN 2/2023 provides information on how your organisation should notify Scottish Ministers of the publication of your annual procurement report for financial years 2022 to 2023 and 2023 to 2024. This includes information on submitting a completed Annex A template.
heading_path: SPPN 2/2023: Public Procurement - Annual Procurement Reports for 2022-23 and 2023-2024

content_blocks.text: Please direct any enquiries on this to Scottishprocurement@gov.scot
heading_path: SPPN 2/2023: Public Procurement - Annual Procurement Reports for 2022-23 and 2023-2024

content_blocks.text: The Procurement Journey guidance will be updated in the coming weeks.
